name: gh-account-switcher
title: GitHub Account Switcher
description: Quickly switch the active gh CLI account across hosts (github.com, GHES).
author: sujha

commands.name: switch-account
commands.title: Switch GitHub Account
commands.subtitle: gh CLI
commands.description: List all gh CLI accounts and switch the active one per host.

commands.name: toggle-account
commands.title: Toggle GitHub Account
commands.subtitle: gh CLI
commands.description: Cycle to the next gh CLI account on github.com (no UI).

commands.name: show-active-account
commands.title: Show Active GitHub Account
commands.subtitle: gh CLI
commands.description: Show the currently active gh CLI account per host as a HUD.

preferences.name: ghPath
preferences.title: gh CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the gh executable. Leave empty for auto-detection.

preferences.name: toggleHost
preferences.title: Toggle Host
preferences.description: Host used by the 'Toggle GitHub Account' command when cycling accounts.

preferences.name: sshKeyMap
preferences.title: SSH Key Map
preferences.description: Optional. Mappings separated by ';' (or ','). Each mapping: 'host:user=/path/to/key' (or 'user=/path/to/key'). Use ~ for home. Example: github.com:work-user=~/.ssh/id_ed25519;github.com:jhasubhash=~/.ssh/id_ed25519_personal

preferences.name: sshConfigPath
preferences.title: SSH Config Path
preferences.description: Optional override for the SSH config file. Defaults to ~/.ssh/config.
